# Di Dee Designers

> Di Dee Designers is a saree pre-pleating and saree draping service in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India. It pre-pleats and drapes the customer's own saree. Customers should share the saree fabric, style and occasion details so suitability and arrangements can be confirmed before booking. Di Dee Designers prepares sarees; it does not sell them.

## Services
- Saree pre-pleating: the customer's own saree is pleated in advance in one of three styles. Suitability for each saree is confirmed before booking.
- Saree draping: contact Di Dee Designers on WhatsApp to discuss your saree, occasion and requirements. A draping price is not published; it is confirmed on enquiry.

## Pre-pleating prices (per saree, INR)
- Box folding (pressed pleats): ₹250 - everyday and office sarees
- Semi-fluffy pleats: ₹300 - functions and festivals
- Full-fluffy pleats with hanger: ₹400 - full-volume pleat style
- Final price is confirmed on WhatsApp before booking.

## Service areas
- Tiruppur, Avinashi and Erode (Tamil Nadu, India). Contact us to confirm availability for your location.

## How to enquire
1. Message +91 90030 37820 on WhatsApp with your location, occasion date, saree type and the service you need.
2. Get the price, suitability confirmation and arrangements before booking.

## Contact
